newsitem.title: THAILAND: Charoen, Bangkok Produce enter insurance.
newsitem.headline: Charoen, Bangkok Produce enter insurance.

text.p: Charoen Pokphand Feedmill Plc said on Thursday it would invest in non-life insurance business Charoen Pokphand Insurance Co Ltd, to be established after receiving approval from the Thai cabinet last month.
Charoen Pokphand Feedmill said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) that it would buy 18 percent of the total 30 million ordinary shares at par 10 baht.
Meanwhile, Bangkok Produce Merchandising Plc also said in another filing to the SET that it would take eight percent of the total shares in Charoen Pokphand Insurance.
Charoen Pokphand Feedmill, Bangkok Produce Merchandising and Charoen Pokphand Insurance are subsidiaries of Charoen Pokphand Group, Thailand's major conglomerate.
